heading: Turnkey Solar Panels and Heat Pumps for Your Home or Agriturismo

sections.title: Sustainable Energy Solutions for Properties in Italy
paragraphs: We help home- and agriturismo-owners in Tuscany transition to efficient, integrated solar PV and heat pump systems tailored to their properties.
Our goal is to reduce energy costs, fossil-fuel consumption and carbon emissions while making the transition as straightforward and reliable as possible.

sections.title: A Complete Turnkey Energy Solution
paragraphs: Domus Zero manages your solar and heat pump project from initial assessment through installation and ongoing support.
items: Assessment of your property and development of a tailored solar PV and heat pump solution
Coordination with your Comune and local electricity provider
Integrated design and installation of solar and heat pump systems
High-quality, efficient and reliable equipment selected for your property
Clear project planning and fixed-price proposals
Management of permits, administration and removal of replaced equipment
Installation planned to minimize disruption to your home or agriturismo
Optional ongoing maintenance and support after installation

sections.title: The Most Reliable Switch to a Sustainable Home

items.title: A Carefree Transition
items.text: We take care of all the details, so you don't have to. Switch to a sustainable home with minimal disruption to your daily life.

items.title: All-Inclusive Turnkey Service
items.text: We plan with your Comune and local electricity provider, apply for government subsidies, dispose of old systems, install a fully integrated sustainable system, and carry out regular servicing if requested.

items.title: From Assessment to Completion in Weeks
items.text: We can move from the initial consultation to completed installation within a matter of weeks.
